title: homalium deplanchei
intro: Homalium deplanchei, commonly known as the Deplanche's Homalium, is a species of flowering plant in the family Salicaceae. It is traditionally used in Southeast Asia for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and relieving pain, making it beneficial for treating various health conditions such as fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Homalium deplanchei include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These compounds have been shown to possess antioxidant and cytotoxic activities, contributing to the plant's potential therapeutic applications.
